one_line_pitch: Evidence-gated document execution for high-stakes business workflows
submission_line: Doctavian converts ProofDesk's approved structured record into the final conditional approval packet, including repeated line items, calculated values, and branch-specific clauses.
acceptance_gate: Modify fixture data and regenerate. Loops, totals, conditional clauses, and exception appendix must change correctly.

criteria.description: Actual Doctavian generation API called (not mocked or free-written by LLM)
criteria.pass_condition: Generate endpoint returns artifact_id and content_hash, state becomes GENERATED
criteria.fail_condition: Generate returns mocked data or LLM-free-written content
criteria.sponsor_quote: actually call Doctavian's generation API to shape a real document
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:45-2:15 — Call Doctavian, show generated artifact with template ID

criteria.description: Generated document contains LOOP — repeated line items from structured record
criteria.pass_condition: Document contains at least 2 repeated line items (Platform $35,000 + Support $7,500)
criteria.fail_condition: No repeated elements or all items hardcoded
criteria.sponsor_quote: loop: quote line items or obligations
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:55 — Show line items in generated approval memo

criteria.description: Generated document contains BRANCHING — different output based on approval status (approve / conditional / reject)
criteria.pass_condition: Document contains approval status branch and conditional clause (e.g. 'renewed insurance required')
criteria.fail_condition: Static document regardless of data, no branching
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:50 — Show 'CONDITIONALLY APPROVED' with insurance renewal obligation

criteria.description: Generated document contains CALCULATIONS — derived values (totals, counts, derived dates)
criteria.pass_condition: Document shows calculated total ($42,500) derived from components ($35,000 + $7,500)
criteria.fail_condition: Totals not computed or hardcoded without derivation
criteria.sponsor_quote: calculation: totals / derived dates / risk count
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:55 — Show calculated quote total in document

criteria.description: Generated document contains optional EXCEPTION-RESOLUTION APPENDIX when resolutions exist
criteria.pass_condition: When resolutions exist, document includes exception/resolution section; when none, section omitted
criteria.fail_condition: No appendix section or appendix always present regardless of data
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:00 — Show insurance resolution appendix in generated memo

criteria.description: Generated document contains THRESHOLD-DEPENDENT CLAUSES (e.g. insurance renewal obligation)
criteria.pass_condition: Document contains threshold-dependent clause tied to insurance date gap
criteria.fail_condition: No conditional obligations based on data thresholds
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:00 — Show 'Renewed insurance certificate required before current policy expires'

criteria.description: Generated document contains EVIDENCE/RESOLUTION REFERENCES back to source facts
criteria.pass_condition: Document references source facts, assertions, or resolutions (not just free text)
criteria.fail_condition: No references to underlying evidence or audit trail
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:05 — Show evidence appendix referencing extracted facts

criteria.description: Document is generated from STRUCTURED RECORD, not free-written by LLM

check_params.flow_must_be: source evidence -> approved typed record -> template logic -> generated artifact
check_params.must_not_be: LLM reads source -> free-writes document -> Doctavian renders

criteria.pass_condition: Data flow is: facts/assertions -> StructuredRecord -> template -> output
criteria.fail_condition: LLM generates document content directly, Doctavian used only as renderer
criteria.sponsor_quote: Do not let an LLM free-write the final document and use Doctavian merely as a renderer
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:45 — Show structured record hash, then generate from that hash

criteria.description: Modifying fixture data deterministically changes the generated document
criteria.pass_condition: Changing input data produces different output (different totals, different status, different clauses)
criteria.fail_condition: Same output regardless of input data
criteria.sponsor_quote: Modify fixture data and regenerate. Loops, totals, conditional clauses, and exception appendix must change correctly.
criteria.demo_script_step: N/A — validation test, not demo step

criteria.description: One-line statement: where Doctavian did the real work
criteria.pass_condition: README contains explicit attribution to Doctavian
criteria.fail_condition: No mention of Doctavian in README
criteria.sponsor_quote: one-line 'where Doctavian did the real work'
